# Organic Standard

> Ukrainian organic certification body providing inspection, certification, and export support services across EU, ISCC, Danube Soya, and other international standards.

Organic Standard is a leading certification company in Ukraine recognized by the EU and Switzerland. The organization specializes in organic crop production, sustainable development, and food production certification with expert teams providing training, expertise, and market development support.

## Key Topics

- Organic certification
- Inspection services
- Export support
- ISCC certification
- EU standards
- Organic production
- Sustainable development
- Crop production
- Food production certification
- Standards compliance
- Training and expertise
- Market development
- Ukraine
- Danube Soya
- FairWild

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://organicstandard.ua/services): Main services page: inspection, certification, export support, training
- [Inspection and Certification](https://organicstandard.ua/services/inspectionandcertification): Inspection and certification services recognized in EU and Switzerland
- [Export Support and Control](https://organicstandard.ua/services/exportsupport): Export support with inspection certificates and COI documentation
- [Training and Expertise](https://organicstandard.ua/services/training-expertise): Training on organic standards and expertise in production implementation

## Certification Standards

- [Certification Standards Overview](https://organicstandard.ua/standards): Overview of certification standards including EU, Canada, USA regulations
- [ISCC Standard Certification](https://organicstandard.ua/standards/iscc-standard): ISCC sustainability and carbon certification for renewable energy
- [Danube Soya Certification](https://organicstandard.ua/standards/donau-soja-europe-soya): Danube Soya certification for GMO-free organic soy production

## Sector-Specific Certification

- [Organic Crop Production](https://organicstandard.ua/services/inspectionandcertification/crop-production): Organic crop certification requirements and international standards
- [Seeds and Planting Material](https://organicstandard.ua/services/inspectionandcertification/seeds-and-planting-material): Certification for organic seed and planting material production
